DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、救急医学部の氷室セナです

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 本日は非番なので、ご連絡いたしました

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それと、最近お会いできず寂しいので、少しお時間を頂けたら嬉しいです

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと待ってね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、公園で待ち合わせをしようか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、救急医学部の氷室セナです

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 再び非番となりましたので、報告いたします

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今日も待機するの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いえ、今日は用事があるので

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私服で救急医学部の部室に行こうと思います

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 非番の日に、私服で部室に……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私も行くよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はい……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いつも忙しいはずでは……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: とにかく行くよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 分かりました

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: では、お待ちしております

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、救急医学部の氷室セナです

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 最近、同じ報告を何度もしている気がしますが……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: セナの非番！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その通りです

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今日は何するの？待機？薬の整備？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日は普段と違う予定があります

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 極めて例外的な状況だと

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ご理解いただけると助かります

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それって……何？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 海を見に行きたいです

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 分かった、私に任せて！

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 덧붙여, 요즘 선생님을 자주 만나지 못해 쓸쓸하니, 시간 약속을 잡았으면 합니다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다시 비번일이 되었기에, 이에 보고드리려 합니다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아닙니다. 오늘은 따로 할 일이 있습니다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 사복을 입고 응급의학부실을 찾으려 합니다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 최근 비슷한 말씀을 자주 드리게 되는 것 같습니다만.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 역시 선생님께는 아무것도 숨길 필요가 없군요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이례적인 일이 발생하였다고 말씀드리려 했던 것은.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 드물게도 저에게, 상정 외의 생각이 떠올랐기 때문이었습니다.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, this is Himuro Sena of the Medical Emergency Club.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I wanted to report that I'm off duty today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: In addition, I would like to schedule a meetup, as I haven't seen you in a while and I'm getting lonely.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Hold on. Let me catch up here.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Okay... Yeah. Sure thing! Let's do that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, this is Himuro Sena of the Medical Emergency Club.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I wanted to report that I'm off duty today as well.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Does that mean you're on standby?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No. I have something else to do today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Which is why I am going to visit the Medical Emergency Club room in my casual outfit.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Club room...on off-duty day...in casual outfit?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll join you!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I don't think there's going to be anything out of the ordinary.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll join you anyway!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hmm.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I understand.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then I'll be expecting you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, this is Himuro Sena of the Medical Emergency Club.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...Hm. I've been repeating myself a lot lately.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It must be your off-duty day!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hmm.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You know me well, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What's on your plate today? Standby? Organizing medicine?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, I wanted to talk to you about that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Something unusual has happened.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I had an unexpected thought, which rarely happens.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What...was it?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I want to go to the beach.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Okay! Leave it to me!!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู ฉันฮิมูโระ เซนะจากชมรม
หน่วยแพทย์ฉุกเฉินค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
วันนี้ฉันเวรออฟ ก็เลยมาแจ้งให้ทราบ
น่ะค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ช่วงนี้ฉันเหงาเพราะไม่ได้เจอคุณครู
บ่อยๆ ฉันก็เลยอยากนัดเจอคุณครูค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวนะ ขอครูทำความเข้าใจก่อน

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
อ๋อ... อื้ม เข้าใจแล้ว!
งั้นก็มาเจอกันเถอะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู ฉันฮิมูโระ เซนะจากชมรม
หน่วยแพทย์ฉุกเฉินค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันได้เวรออฟอีกแล้ว ก็เลยมาแจ้งให้
ทราบค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
วันนี้ก็จะเตรียมพร้อมทำงานอีก
หรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ค่ะ วันนี้ฉันมีงานอื่น

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็เลยจะใส่ชุดลำลองไปห้องชมรม
หน่วยแพทย์ฉุกเฉินค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
เวรออฟ... แต่จะใส่ชุดลำลอง...
ไปห้องชมรมเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: งั้นครูไปด้วย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ฉันว่าไม่น่าจะมีเรื่องอะไรเป็นพิเศษ
นะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เอาเถอะน่า ครูไปด้วยดีกว่า!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เข้าใจแล้วค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วเจอกันนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครูคะ ฉันฮิมูโระ เซนะจากชมรม
หน่วยแพทย์ฉุกเฉินค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เหมือนหมู่นี้ฉันเอาแต่พูดเรื่องเดิมๆ
ยังไงก็ไม่รู้

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เวรออฟอีกแล้วสินะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันปิดบังอะไรคุณครูไม่ได้เลยสินะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
วันนี้ก็เตรียมพร้อมรอทำงานหรือเปล่า?
หรือว่าไปจัดเรียงยา?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ค่ะ ฉันติดต่อมาเพราะเรื่องนั้นละค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันพยายามจะบอกคุณครูว่ามีบางอย่าง
ที่ผิดปกติกับฉัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพราะฉันมีความคิดที่เหนือความคาด
หมายค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มันคือ... อะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันอยากไปทะเลดูบ้างค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ได้สิ! ให้เป็นหน้าที่ของครูเอง!!!

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，我是急救醫學部的氷室瀬奈

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因為最近很少見到老師讓我很寂寞，希望可以跟老師約個時間見面

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 唔嗯……我明白了！就這麼決定吧！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，我是急救醫學部的氷室瀬奈

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 報告老師，又到了我的休假日

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以才會穿著便服到急救醫學部的部室

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我想應該不會有什麼特別的……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，我是急救醫學部的氷室瀬奈

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然感覺最近好像總是跟老師說一樣的話，不過……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 果然什麼事都瞞不過老師呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 今天要待命嗎？還是整理藥品？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我正打算跟你說這方面的事

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因為發生了極為例外的情況

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我難得浮現了出乎意料的想法
